task: Reconcile pinned Team B runtime with the frozen ABI-v10 Map contract.
observation: Team B's runtime and report described bucket-indexed vector chains, while ABI_V10_DESIGN.md requires robin-hood open addressing for the production MossMap kernel.
impact: Unit and multi-crate runtime checks passed before integration, but that green evidence did not establish the frozen storage algorithm or its deletion behavior under collisions.
evidence: runtime/moss_runtime/src/map.rs: pinned Team B bucket-vector representation
tests/phase25/runtime/check_runtime.py: debug/release runtime and source-removal checks

resolution.summary: Replaced bucket chains with robin-hood slots and backward-shift deletion; added a collision-heavy ordered-map oracle. Team B debug/release runtime suite passes after the change. Compiler lowering and key-proof integration remain pending.

After moving the exact Team S implementation into moss_runtime, the first source-removal build still rejected a valid v10 provider as plain because the v10 interface omitted its String representation record.
impact: A locally successful provider/consumer build did not establish source-free compatibility; only physically removing the provider source exposed the missing contract metadata.
